verdict.rationale: Certified models and durability are a fair question for a hardware security key, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions FIPS 140 validation, Common Criteria certification, or documented water or crush resistance. The only durability-related items are community remarks about USB port wear, which do not document ruggedness.

support.subject: As an IT admin, certified models exist for regulated environments — FIPS 140 validated or Common Criteria certified — with documented durability (water/crush resistance)
